The vertical asymptotic axis in recursion frame Rₙ. It arises from the unresolved paradox at the center of Gₙ and reorients in each new frame.

The structural balance line (e.g., Yₙ = Xₙ) that becomes asymptotic to Gₙ and defines the point of paradox (Pₙ).
The smallest stable instance of parametric recursion in a frame. A tightly curved orbit around Yₙ; below this scale, structure collapses into paradox and seeds Big-R Recursion.
The resolution limit of parametric recursion in Rₙ. At this scale, the frame flattens into structural stillness and transitions into the void, initiating Oₙ₊₁.
Not an act but a structural inflection. Naming is the collapse of infinite potential into local flatness—the selection of a recursion origin and the birth of a frame.
The structural selection of a local recursion frame (Oₙ), flattening global curvature into experience. Observation does not alter reality—it defines the frame of its unfolding.
The condition that all experience appears flat locally because each point observed is the center of its own recursion frame.
The pre-structural, infinitely divisible, paradoxically balanced state. No structure, only potential. Structural recursion begins from the void.
